name: Conceptual Physics Assessment / Evidence Retrieval Profile
authority_note: Original Unit Assessment Plan HTML is authoritative; this file only makes repeated course evidence language easy to retrieve.

progress_language.Not Yet: learning outcome still developing; more practice, feedback, and evidence needed
progress_language.Approaching: growth is visible; more evidence is needed for consistent mastery
progress_language.Meeting: sufficient evidence of mastering the learning outcome
progress_language.Exceeding: evidence of applying skills/concepts beyond the expected challenge

bank_design_consequences: Design evidence first at the exact I-can level, then aggregate upward to Learning Targets and Mastery Goals.
Evidence accumulates across independent opportunities toward Mastery Goals.
DOK describes actual thinking after design; it is not a quota.
Meeting does not require perfection; sufficient accurate independent evidence across the Mastery Goal matters.
Exceeding can emerge through transfer/modeling/evaluation in unfamiliar situations rather than a mandatory special item.

i_can_role.atomic_evidence_address: Each exact I-can is the smallest required curriculum/evidence address used for planning and routing.
i_can_role.learning_target_role: Groups related I-cans into a coherent section-level target.
i_can_role.mastery_goal_role: Organizes and reports accumulated evidence across multiple I-cans/sections.
i_can_role.consequence: A student/resource cannot be considered fully covered merely because the Learning Target or Mastery Goal has many questions; each exact I-can needs direct evidence opportunities.
